items.title: Con-call: customer asks about the excursion

turns.speaker: Mark (Customer QE)
turns.text: Thanks for joining. Can you walk us through the failure signature first?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Sure. The failures are concentrated in two wafers, both from the same furnace batch.

turns.speaker: Mark (Customer QE)
turns.text: Is it random, or does it follow a pattern on the wafer?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: It follows a clear edge ring. That rules out a random particle defect.

turns.speaker: Mark (Customer QE)
turns.text: Understood. How much material is affected, and how much has shipped to us?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Forty-six lots in total. Twelve of them have already shipped to your site.

turns.speaker: Mark (Customer QE)
turns.text: That is a lot. What is your containment plan for the shipped material?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: We ask you to quarantine the remaining stock while we screen the sister lots.

turns.speaker: Mark (Customer QE)
turns.text: And when can we expect the interim report?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: By Wednesday next week. The confirmed root cause will follow in work week thirty-six.

questions.q: What does the edge ring pattern tell the engineer?
options: The failures are caused by random particles
The failures are systematic, not random
Only one die per wafer failed
questions.explain_zh: That rules out a random particle defect —— 有規律的分佈代表系統性的製程問題。這是 FA 對話裡最常出現的第一個判斷。

questions.q: How many lots have already shipped to the customer?
questions.explain_zh: Forty-six lots in total. Twelve of them have already shipped。總數與已出貨數是兩個不同的數字，聽的時候要分開記。

questions.q: What does the engineer ask the customer to do?
questions.explain_zh: We ask you to quarantine the remaining stock —— 隔離庫存是圍堵動作，不等於退貨或停線。

dictation.text: Forty-six lots are affected, and twelve of them have already shipped.
The confirmed root cause will follow in work week thirty-six.

items.title: Daily yield meeting with the fab

turns.speaker: Lisa (Fab PE)
turns.text: Good morning. Let us start with yesterday's sort yield.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: The line average was ninety-three point two percent, which is on baseline.

turns.speaker: Lisa (Fab PE)
turns.text: Any lot below the excursion limit?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: One lot came in at eighty-seven point five percent. It is on hold now.

turns.speaker: Lisa (Fab PE)
turns.text: Do we know what is different about that lot?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: It is the only lot that went through the backup etcher last Friday.

turns.speaker: Lisa (Fab PE)
turns.text: Then let us pull the tool logs before we release anything else.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Agreed. I will have the commonality analysis ready by this afternoon.

questions.q: What was the line average sort yield?
questions.explain_zh: ninety-three point two percent。會議裡數字往往連續出現，要分清楚哪個是平均、哪個是異常批。

questions.q: Why is the low lot suspicious?
options: It is the oldest lot in the fab
It is the only lot that used the backup etcher
It came from a different customer
questions.explain_zh: the only lot that went through the backup etcher —— 這就是 tool commonality 的思路：找出唯一不同的地方。

questions.q: What is the agreed next step?
options: Pull the tool logs before releasing other material
Ship the lot with a waiver
questions.explain_zh: let us pull the tool logs before we release anything else —— 先查再放行，是標準的圍堵順序。

dictation.text: The line average was ninety-three point two percent yesterday.
That lot came in at eighty-seven point five percent and is now on hold.

turns.speaker: You (Customer)
turns.text: We found the film thickness on your last shipment is outside our spec.

turns.speaker: Dan (Supplier FAE)
turns.text: Could you share the measured values? We did not see a flag on our side.

turns.speaker: You (Customer)
turns.text: Our incoming data shows two hundred and fifteen nanometres against a limit of two hundred.

turns.speaker: Dan (Supplier FAE)
turns.text: That is above our control limit too. Let me check the batch record.

turns.speaker: You (Customer)
turns.text: While you check, I need two things: tightened inspection and a recovery date.

turns.speaker: Dan (Supplier FAE)
turns.text: We can add one hundred percent inspection starting next week.

turns.speaker: You (Customer)
turns.text: Next week is too late. Our build starts on Monday.

turns.speaker: Dan (Supplier FAE)
turns.text: Then we will inspect the current stock this weekend and confirm on Sunday.

turns.speaker: You (Customer)
turns.text: Good. Please send written confirmation with the action items today.

questions.q: What is the measured value versus the limit?
questions.explain_zh: two hundred and fifteen nanometres against a limit of two hundred。against 前面是實測值，後面是規格。

questions.q: What two things does the customer demand?
options: Tightened inspection and a recovery date
A new supplier and a credit note
A site visit and a report
questions.explain_zh: I need two things: tightened inspection and a recovery date —— 提出要求時先講數量再逐項列出，對方比較不會漏。

questions.q: How does the customer push back on the supplier's first offer?
options: By threatening to cancel the contract
By pointing out that the build starts on Monday
By asking for a lower price
questions.explain_zh: Next week is too late. Our build starts on Monday —— 用自己的時程當理由施壓，比單純說 too late 有力。

dictation.text: Our incoming data shows two hundred and fifteen nanometres against a limit of two hundred.
We can add one hundred percent inspection starting next week.

turns.speaker: Karen (Auditor)
turns.text: We have three findings. Two are minor and one is major.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Could you walk us through the major one first?

turns.speaker: Karen (Auditor)
turns.text: Traceability records for reworked wafers were incomplete in two of the ten lots we sampled.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: We accept the finding. Those lots were reworked during a system upgrade.

turns.speaker: Karen (Auditor)
turns.text: Does that mean the material history is unknown?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: No. The records are incomplete, but we can rebuild the history from the tool logs.

turns.speaker: Karen (Auditor)
turns.text: Please include that evidence in your response. When can we expect it?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Within thirty days, together with the corrective action for the manual entry.

questions.q: How many lots were sampled, and how many had incomplete records?
questions.explain_zh: two of the ten lots we sampled。X of the Y 這個結構在稽核與品質對話裡非常常見，要習慣拆開聽。

questions.q: How does the engineer limit the scope of the finding?
options: By saying the records are incomplete but the history can be rebuilt
questions.explain_zh: The records are incomplete, but we can rebuild the history from the tool logs —— 先接受缺失，再把影響範圍縮到「紀錄」而非「材料」。

questions.q: What is the promised response time?
questions.explain_zh: Within thirty days，並且要連矯正措施一起交。稽核回覆的期限通常寫在稽核程序裡，不要口頭承諾更短的時間。

dictation.text: Traceability records were incomplete in two of the ten lots we sampled.
We will respond within thirty days with the corrective action.

items.title: FA result review with the customer

turns.speaker: Steve (Customer QE)
turns.text: We received your failure analysis report. I have a few questions on the method.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Of course. Which part would you like me to expand on?

turns.speaker: Steve (Customer QE)
turns.text: You applied one million read cycles. How did you choose that number?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: It is ten times the read count assumed in our qualification model.

turns.speaker: Steve (Customer QE)
turns.text: And the threshold voltage shifted by how much?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: One hundred and twenty millivolts on the adjacent page, fully recovered after erase.

turns.speaker: Steve (Customer QE)
turns.text: So you are saying the cells are not damaged.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Correct. The shift is reversible, which points to disturb rather than physical damage.

turns.speaker: Steve (Customer QE)
turns.text: Then we should compare our usage model with your assumption.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: That is exactly what we would like to propose as the next step.

questions.q: Why did the team choose one million read cycles?
options: It is the maximum the tester supports
It is ten times the qualified read count
questions.explain_zh: ten times the read count assumed in our qualification model。被問「為什麼選這個條件」時，要能把數字連回認證假設。

questions.q: What does the full recovery after erase indicate?
options: The shift is reversible, so it is disturb rather than damage
questions.explain_zh: The shift is reversible, which points to disturb rather than physical damage —— 可逆性是這類問題的關鍵證據。

questions.q: What is proposed as the next step?
options: A comparison of the usage model and the qualification assumption
questions.explain_zh: compare our usage model with your assumption —— 把問題轉成雙方一起做的事，比直接說責任在客戶更容易推進。

dictation.text: We applied one million read cycles at eighty-five degrees.
The threshold voltage shifted by one hundred and twenty millivolts.

items.title: Kickoff: qualification plan for a new product

turns.speaker: Priya (Program Manager)
turns.text: The customer wants samples in work week forty and production in work week forty-eight.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: That is tight. The reliability stress alone takes one thousand hours.

turns.speaker: Priya (Program Manager)
turns.text: Can we run anything in parallel?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Yes. We can start endurance and retention at the same time if we have enough units.

turns.speaker: Priya (Program Manager)
turns.text: How many units do you need in total?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Seventy-seven units per condition, so about three hundred for the full plan.

turns.speaker: Priya (Program Manager)
turns.text: I will check the build. What is the main risk you want to flag?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: If the first build slips by two weeks, the production date cannot hold.

questions.q: What are the two dates the customer wants?
options: Samples in WW40, production in WW48
Samples in WW48, production in WW40
Samples in WW36, production in WW40
Samples in WW40, production in WW44
questions.explain_zh: samples in work week forty and production in work week forty-eight。兩個週次連著唸時最容易記反，聽到就要立刻記下來。

questions.q: How many units are needed for the full plan?
questions.explain_zh: Seventy-seven units per condition, so about three hundred for the full plan。per condition 與 total 是兩個層級的數字。

questions.q: What risk does the engineer flag?
options: A two-week slip in the first build breaks the production date
questions.explain_zh: If the first build slips by two weeks, the production date cannot hold —— 示警要具體到條件與後果。

dictation.text: The customer wants samples in work week forty and production in work week forty-eight.
We need seventy-seven units per condition, about three hundred in total.

items.title: Escalation call: shipment hold and recovery

turns.speaker: Robert (Customer Director)
turns.text: I joined this call because we missed the committed date twice.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Understood. Let me give you the current status and a date we can hold.

turns.speaker: Robert (Customer Director)
turns.text: Please keep it short. What is blocking you today?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: The verification lots are still in the furnace. They come out on Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: Robert (Customer Director)
turns.text: And if they pass?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: We release on Friday and ship four thousand units the same day.

turns.speaker: Robert (Customer Director)
turns.text: What if they fail?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Then we fall back to the screened material, which covers sixty percent of your demand.

turns.speaker: Robert (Customer Director)
turns.text: That is the answer I needed. Send me both scenarios in writing today.

questions.q: Why did the director join the call?
options: Because the committed date was missed twice
questions.explain_zh: we missed the committed date twice —— 跳票兩次就是升級的門檻，這時對方要的是可靠的日期，不是技術細節。

questions.q: What does the engineer do well in this call?
options: Gives both the success case and the fallback case
questions.explain_zh: 通過就週五出貨，沒通過就退回篩選料。管理層問話時，同時給 plan A 與 plan B 才是專業的回答。

questions.q: How much of the demand does the fallback cover?
questions.explain_zh: the screened material, which covers sixty percent of your demand。備案要講出涵蓋率，對方才知道缺口多大。

dictation.text: We release on Friday and ship four thousand units the same day.
The screened material covers sixty percent of your demand.

items.title: Small talk and agenda setting before a review

turns.speaker: Emily (Customer QE)
turns.text: Hi Jerry, good to see you again. How was your trip to Boise?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Long but useful. The time difference is fourteen hours, so I am still adjusting.

turns.speaker: Emily (Customer QE)
turns.text: I know that feeling. Did you get to see the new fab?

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Only from outside, but the scale is impressive.

turns.speaker: Emily (Customer QE)
turns.text: Nice. Shall we get started? I have a hard stop at half past ten.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Sure. I have three topics and they should take twenty minutes.

turns.speaker: Emily (Customer QE)
turns.text: Perfect. Let us leave the cost discussion for the next call.

turns.speaker: You (Engineer)
turns.text: Agreed. Then I will focus on yield, the open 8D, and the sample schedule.

questions.q: What does 'a hard stop at half past ten' mean?
options: She must leave the meeting at 10:30
The call will be recorded until 10:30
questions.explain_zh: hard stop 是「時間一到我一定要離開」，聽到就要立刻壓縮議程。這是外商會議最常見的用語之一。

questions.q: How does the engineer respond to the time pressure?
options: By stating the number of topics and how long they will take
questions.explain_zh: I have three topics and they should take twenty minutes —— 用數量與時間回應時間壓力，對方立刻知道行不行得通。

questions.q: Which topic is postponed?
questions.explain_zh: Let us leave the cost discussion for the next call。會前把議題砍掉是常態，記得會後在信裡確認被砍的項目何時談。

dictation.text: The time difference is fourteen hours.
I have three topics and they should take twenty minutes.
